title: The app garden got substantially weirder
summary:
A community harvest: a sizable new app catalog, Gemini tool support, and quieter improvements beneath the flowerbed.

The community showcase added a large crop of creative tools: AI Story Illustrator, imgs_ai_bot, ChimeraStudio, Storycraft Pro, Sugen, Imagly AI, BinaryPH RSS AI, CHRONOS Time Machine, and Viral Flow. There is now more machinery for turning prompts into images, stories, feeds, and whatever a time machine counts as.

Games and learning gained Nikke-DB Story/Roleplaying Generator, ii's Stupid Menu, a DnD Character Sheet Helper, Kinexus, and Word Master. The catalog continues to make a convincing case that AI infrastructure should occasionally be allowed to have fun.

New community apps cover calorie tracking, tone rewriting, general chat, YouTube search, a Pollinations Codex, and content automation. Instagram automation also joined the news feed, because apparently the internet still requires posts.
